metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to search for drip coffee makers on Google Shopping but encountered SSL cert error (NET::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID). Navigated to Amazon instead, searched 'drip coffee maker', applied color/price/deals filters, scrolled results. Later tried Google Shopping URL but landed on Best Buy. Failed after 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome address bar, type URLs, search products on Amazon, use search filters (color, price, deals), scroll through results, interact with web elements
metadata.failure_analysis: Google Shopping inaccessible due to SSL certificate error. Model could not bypass the cert error and tried alternative shopping sites instead. Evaluator expected Google Shopping-specific URL and filter states.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original complex shopping task into a simple Chrome internal navigation task. Model demonstrated ability to type URLs in address bar, so navigating to chrome://bookmarks is within demonstrated capability and avoids SSL issues.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's bookmarks manager page (chrome://bookmarks). Evaluator uses URL pattern matching to verify the active tab URL contains 'chrome://bookmarks'. Uses official getter active_url_from_accessTree and metric is_expected_url_pattern_match.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation to chrome://bookmarks.

Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match uses re.search to find the pattern 'chrome://bookmarks' in the URL, which will correctly match even though the getter prepends a default 'https://' prefix to the address bar text.
Expected value 'chrome://bookmarks' is the correct URL for Chrome's bookmarks manager page.
The metric receives the rules dict directly (with key 'expected'), and accesses rules['expected'] correctly to get the pattern list.
Single-step instruction with single verification check provides complete coverage.
Minor note: the getter's default goto_prefix='https://' will produce 'https://chrome://bookmarks' which is semantically odd but does not break the regex search match.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider passing goto_prefix as empty string or 'chrome://' in the getter config to avoid the redundant 'https://' prefix on chrome:// URLs, though this is cosmetic and does not affect correctness.
